title: The $10K Month
logline: I'm taking my small bookkeeping firm in Conroe, Texas, and turning it into the national real estate bookkeeper, one client at a time.
seasonQuestion: Can a small local Conroe firm become the national real estate bookkeeper? $10K a month is the scoreboard.
